Package gooeygui

Class Slider

java.lang.Object
gooeygui.Component
gooeygui.Slider
public class Slider extends Component
A bar with a knob the user can drag to choose a whole number within a range. 

 //                     min, max, start, x,  y,   width, height
 Slider volume = new Slider(0, 100, 50,  50, 100, 200,   40);
 volume.setOnChange(this::updateVolume);
 window.addComponent(volume);

  • Constructor Details

    • Slider

      public Slider(int min, int max, int startingValue, int x, int y, int width, int height)
      Constructs a horizontal slider with the given range and starting value.
      Parameters:
      min - the smallest value the slider can have
      max - the largest value the slider can have
      startingValue - the value the slider starts at, from min to max
      x - the x-coordinate of the top-left corner, in pixels
      y - the y-coordinate of the top-left corner, in pixels
      width - the width of the slider, in pixels (at least 1)
      height - the height of the slider, in pixels (at least 1)
      Throws:
      GooeyGUIException - if min is greater than max, if startingValue is outside the range, or if width or height is less than 1

      public int getValue()
      Returns the slider's current value.

    • setValue

      public void setValue(int value)
      Moves the knob to the given value. This also runs the change action.
      Parameters:
      value - the new value, from the minimum to the maximum
      Throws:
      GooeyGUIException - if value is outside the slider's range

      public int getMinimum()

    • getMaximum

      public int getMaximum()
      Returns the largest value the slider can have.
      Returns:
      the maximum value

    • setMinimum

      public void setMinimum(int min)
      Sets the smallest value the slider can have. If the current value is below the new minimum, the knob moves up to the minimum.
      Parameters:
      min - the new minimum value
      Throws:
      GooeyGUIException - if min is greater than the current maximum

    • setMaximum

      public void setMaximum(int max)
      Sets the largest value the slider can have. If the current value is above the new maximum, the knob moves down to the maximum.
      Parameters:
      max - the new maximum value
      Throws:
      GooeyGUIException - if max is less than the current minimum

    • setOnChange

      public void setOnChange(Runnable changeAction)
      Sets the method to run whenever the slider's value changes. The method runs many times while the user is dragging the knob, not just once at the end.
      Parameters:
      changeAction - the method to run, written as this::methodName, or null to remove the action
